[message] &#e2b04a&l✦ Cobblemon Origins Rules ✦
[message] &#f7d27a1. &#fff1d0Be respectful. No harassment, hate speech or discrimination.
[message] &#f7d27a2. &#fff1d0No cheating: no hacked clients, x-ray, duping or exploits. Report bugs to staff.
[message] &#f7d27a3. &#fff1d0No griefing or stealing, including with claims: never claim around, inside or next to another player's build to block, trap or take it.
[message] &#f7d27a4. &#fff1d0No scamming in trades. Agree on a deal before you trade Pokémon or items.
[message] &#f7d27a5. &#fff1d0No spam, advertising or excessive caps in chat.
[message] &#f7d27a6. &#fff1d0Keep builds, names and skins appropriate.
[message] &#f7d27a7. &#fff1d0No lag machines or farms that hurt server performance.
[message] &#f7d27a8. &#fff1d0Staff decisions are final. Ask on Discord if something is unclear.
[message] &#9aa6c4Breaking the rules can lead to a mute, kick or ban. Appeals: /discord
